name: qm
install: git clone --branch v0.1.15 <repo> && build as deploy/core/Dockerfile does (npm ci --omit=dev, connector-sdk build); see Dockerfile
entry: /opt/harness/adapter.sh run | serve (task container in compose.yaml; HE_ENTRY selects it)
turn_command: node qm-api.mjs turn: POST /v1/turns {surface:'harness-eval', actor:{externalId:'U1'}, conversation:{kind:'dm', threadRef:<trial>}, text:<instruction.md>} signed with CORE_SIGNING_SECRET
state_paths: sandbox volume qm-home-<scope> (/root, the agent's workspace; removed by capture.sh)
mcp_config_path: QM's MCP server registry: PUT /v1/admin/mcp-servers/world at serve start (name world, url HE_WORLD_MCP_URL, auth bearer with HE_WORLD_MCP_TOKEN, credentialScope shared, readOnly false), as admin principal harness-admin (ADMIN_GRANTS in config/core.env); core probes tools/list before saving
sandbox_backend: local (one Docker container per scope via the host socket; image Dockerfile.sandbox)
multi_user_mode: QM scopes: personal:<slack user id> for a DM, channel:<id> for a channel; the actor is the requester's Slack user id on every turn
serve_turn_command: node qm-api.mjs turn: POST /v1/turns {surface:'harness-eval', actor:{externalId:<requester slack_user_id>, displayName}, conversation:{kind:'dm', threadRef:'dm:<member>'} | {kind:'channel', threadRef:'channel:<id>', channelRef:<id>, channelName}, text:<prompt>}

serve.session_key: conversation.threadRef dm:<member> | channel:<id>; scope personal:<actor> | channel:<id>
serve.shared_between_sessions: whatever QM shares across scopes under HARNESS_SHARING_POSTURE=isolated; not configured by the adapter
serve.exit_mapping: status ok, silent or pending_approval -> 0; request outlived the budget -> 124; refusalKind model_budget or a provider status in reason -> 3; else 2
